name: cyberrakshak/monitor
description: Cyber Rakshak error monitoring for PHP: uncaught exceptions, fatal errors and (if you like) warnings, scrubbed of secrets, sent to your site's Errors page. One class, no dependencies.

authors.name: Laabam One Business Solutions (OPC) Private Limited

suggest.ext-curl: Sends reports with curl; without it, PHP's own HTTP streams are used.
suggest.ext-mbstring: Cuts long texts with mbstring; without it, the library does the same itself.
